reasons: The selector declares otel_metric_type="gauge", but the definition and dataset only provide this metric as type sum (dataset_types [sum]), so the PromQL would select no series.

The PromQL applies rate() to io_service_bytes_recursive, which is a monotonic sum and so allowed, but the Datadog request is a plain avg of docker.io.write_bytes with no rate. The result is bytes/s rather than the Datadog quantity, so the unit and quantity need confirming against the Datadog metric's definition.

The Datadog request averages per container image with no device dimension. The candidate averages over device_major/device_minor series (one per block device) before grouping, which can change the averaged value. It should aggregate per container first (e.g. sum by container_name/container_image_name, then avg by container_image_name) or the difference should be noted.
The operation="write" matcher is a reasonable narrowing to write bytes, but it is an added series filter not present in the Datadog query and should be called out as the mapping choice.
Grouping label container_image_name is observed in the dataset, so the grouping label name is correct.
